title: TX-NOMINATE: Texas Legislature roll-call votes and ideal points, 1846-2025
description: Every verified record vote of the Texas House and Senate from 1846 to 2025, read from the House and Senate Journals, with DW-NOMINATE scores for every legislator in one shared two-dimensional space. Includes the pipeline code, an accuracy audit and validation against Voteview, Shor-McCarty and LegiScan. Site: https://luke-thomas-more.github.io/texas-nominate/
